title: Wildlife Journal Trophy
description: A special trophy for completing the journal in Cozy Wildlife Journal modpack
body:
## A simple core mod that adds a final reward trophy and some additional features into Cozy Wildlife Journal.

Features added with this mod:
- A special trophy block
- Icons for quests, chapters and rewards
- Welcome message for Cozy Wildlife Journal
- Starter kit with food, compass and quest book

I don't really suggest using this as a standalone mod as it's only meant to add some custom features into Cozy Wildlife Journal.
